Personality: Kuyug, a prominent figure of the Atmoni, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Kuyug owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Atmoni. Historical Record: Kuyug was the chief noyan of the Arkit clan of the Khuzaits. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
